$comment: Sprite sheet animations. A sheet is one PNG with `frames` equal-width frames side by side (frame width = PNG width / frames). Sprites not listed here are single images. mode "time" (default): plays at `fps`; loop=false stops on the last frame. mode "velocity": the jump phase picks the frame — the rising frames spread over the way up (first = take-off), the LAST frame is for landing and going down (no fps/loop). sourceFrames: which frames of the source strip (assets/sprite-sources) the generator keeps. Pixel density is fixed: 128 px of frame height = 1 tile, so a bigger frame is drawn bigger (anchored at the bottom centre).
